newsitem.title: GERMANY: Young & Rubicam's German unit chief steps down.
newsitem.headline: Young & Rubicam's German unit chief steps down.

text.p: Ingo Krauss, chairman and chief executive officer of advertising group Young & Rubicam's German unit, is leaving the agency, industry magazine Text Intern said on Tuesday.
After almost 30 years with the company, Krauss is stepping down and will be replaced by the former chief executive of the group's Dutch unit, Tiemen Bosma, Text Intern said.
A spokeswoman from Young & Rubicam in Germany declined to confirm the report.
Young & Rubicam employees about 470 people in Germany and represented advertising volume of over 750 million marks in 1996, making it the fourth largest ad agency in the country.
